description: On a dynaset over G with held Fields ID, T, N, U at row 'r1': read all four; AddNew, EditMode, read all four (generated ID, default N, unset T, U); set T 'a1', read ID and N; CancelUpdate, EditMode, read all four; AddNew, read ID; set T 'a2' and U 'ua2'; Update; EditMode, read all four, LastModified; MoveLast and read all four; then MoveFirst and walk all fields to EOF. Asks the AddNew buffer values, generated and default value timing, whether a cancelled AddNew consumes a counter, and the current row after AddNew/Update. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
